chemistry-killer-01.title: Kiyayewar mass, ƙayyadadden rabon abubuwa, exothermic da endothermic (Inquiry)
chemistry-killer-01.topic: Kiyayewar mass, ƙayyadadden rabon abubuwa, exothermic da endothermic (Inquiry)
chemistry-killer-01.goal: Analyze the principles of Kiyayewar mass, ƙayyadadden rabon abubuwa, exothermic da endothermic (Inquiry) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.
chemistry-killer-01.material:
A wani gwaji an sa foda na copper (Cu) ya amsa da oxygen ($\mathrm{O_2}$) a cikin kwantena mai rufi domin a samar da copper(II) oxide ($\mathrm{CuO}$). A duk gwaje-gwajen, $\mathrm{O_2}$ a cikin kwantena shi ne 2.0 g kuma amsawar ita ce $\mathrm{2Cu + O_2 \rightarrow 2CuO}$. Taron CuO da aka samu bayan amsawa kamar haka ne.
(I) Cu 4.0 g → CuO 5.0 g
(II) Cu 8.0 g → CuO 10.0 g
(III) Cu 12.0 g → CuO 10.0 g
Idan dokar tsayayyen rabo tana aiki a yanayi ɗaya, wane sakamako ne daidai idan Cu 14.0 g da $\mathrm{O_2}$ 4.0 g sun amsa a kwantena ɗaya har sai ɗaya daga cikin masu amsawa ya ƙare?
chemistry-killer-01.thinking.0: Kiyayewar mass, ƙayyadadden rabon abubuwa, exothermic da endothermic (Inquiry)
chemistry-killer-01.s.s1.prompt:
A wani gwaji an sa foda na copper (Cu) ya amsa da oxygen ($\mathrm{O_2}$) a cikin kwantena mai rufi domin a samar da copper(II) oxide ($\mathrm{CuO}$). A duk gwaje-gwajen, $\mathrm{O_2}$ a cikin kwantena shi ne 2.0 g kuma amsawar ita ce $\mathrm{2Cu + O_2 \rightarrow 2CuO}$. Taron CuO da aka samu bayan amsawa kamar haka ne.
(I) Cu 4.0 g → CuO 5.0 g
(II) Cu 8.0 g → CuO 10.0 g
(III) Cu 12.0 g → CuO 10.0 g
Idan dokar tsayayyen rabo tana aiki a yanayi ɗaya, wane sakamako ne daidai idan Cu 14.0 g da $\mathrm{O_2}$ 4.0 g sun amsa a kwantena ɗaya har sai ɗaya daga cikin masu amsawa ya ƙare?
chemistry-killer-01.s.s1.explain:
Mataki na 1: A (III), inda CuO ba ya ƙaruwa sama da 10.0 g ko da an ƙara Cu, duk $\mathrm{O_2}$ 2.0 g na cikin kwantena ya amsa, don haka CuO 10.0 g = Cu 8.0 g + O 2.0 g, wato Cu:O = 4:1 (tabbatarwa: a (I) Cu 4.0 g + O 1.0 g = 5.0 g don haka O ya rage, a (II) Cu 8.0 g + O 2.0 g = 10.0 g babu ƙari ko rashi, kuma a (III) Cu 4.0 g ya rage).
Mataki na 2: Taron O da ke amsawa gaba ɗaya da Cu 14.0 g = $14.0 \times \frac{1}{4} = 3.5$ g. $\mathrm{O_2}$ 4.0 g da aka bayar ya fi haka yawa, don haka Cu yana amsawa gaba ɗaya kuma $\mathrm{O_2}$ $4.0-3.5=0.5$ g ya rage.
Mataki na 3: CuO da aka samu = 14.0 + 3.5 = 17.5 g (kiyaye taro, rabo Cu:O:CuO = 4:1:5).
Don haka amsar da ta dace ita ce a: an samu CuO 17.5 g, $\mathrm{O_2}$ 0.5 g ya rage. (Kuskure: jimillar taro 18.0 g tana ƙunshe da O da bai amsa ba, 20.0 g ƙima ce da aka lissafa daga O 4.0 g ba tare da la'akari da ƙarancin Cu ba)
chemistry-killer-01.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
